Summary
Founder and CEO of Gridwise, a pre-seed climate-tech startup that cuts electricity bills for small manufacturers by shifting machine loads away from peak-price hours. Former energy analyst with six years at an electric utility. Looking for an accelerator to reach our first 20 paying customers.

Experience
Founder & CEO — Gridwise, Austin, TX  Jan 2025 – Present
Built the load-shifting scheduler (Python, TimescaleDB) and signed 3 paid pilots with machine shops in Central Texas.
Pilots cut peak-demand charges by 18% on average over 4 months ($2,300 a month saved at the largest site).
Raised $150,000 from angels and a Texas climate grant; team of 3 (CTO + part-time sales).

Forecast commercial demand for 40,000 business accounts; models cut forecasting error by 22%.
Designed a demand-response pilot with 120 industrial customers that shaved 14 MW off summer peaks.
